# **FAQS**

#### Why is DM Construction Services the best choice for my project?

Choosing DM Construction Services for your general contracting needs in Southwest Florida ensures a seamless, high-quality construction experience. With extensive local expertise, a skilled and dedicated team, and a comprehensive range of services, we prioritize your vision and satisfaction. Our commitment to using top-quality materials, staying on schedule and within budget, and employing sustainable practices guarantees exceptional results. **Trust DM Construction Services to turn your project into a reality.**

#### Do you do commercial and residential work?

**Yes, we provide both commercial and residential services.** Whether you're looking to enhance your business premises or make improvements to your home, our team is equipped and experienced to handle projects of any scale.

When choosing a commercial development site, it's crucial to evaluate factors such as accessibility, zoning regulations, market demand, and infrastructure. Conducting a thorough analysis of these aspects will help ensure the site aligns with your project goals and contributes to its long-term success.

**Contact us for more details on how we can meet your specific needs.**

#### What materials do you use for your projects?

We use only the best materials, renowned for their superior quality and durability. These materials come with a comprehensive warranty, ensuring long-lasting performance and giving you peace of mind. **We guarantee that your project is completed with top-tier materials that stand the test of time.**

#### What warranties do you offer?

DM Construction Services offers a 1-year workmanship warranty on all our services.

#### How long do your projects take?

The duration of a renovation project can vary depending on factors such as the size of your house, the extent of the work needed, and weather conditions. We strive to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high-quality standards. During your initial consultation, we can provide an estimate of the timeline specific to your project.

#### Do you have financing options available?

**Yes, we do! Our finance partner is Acorn Finance.** They offer a range of flexible financing solutions tailored to meet your needs. For more details on how you can take advantage of these financing options, please contact our customer service team.

#### What types of lending options does Acorn Finance offer?

**PERSONAL LOANS:** A personal loan is a financial product that allows a customer to borrow money now, and pay it back over time by making fixed monthly payments. Personal loans have fixed rates of interest and typically have terms ranging from 2 to 12 years. They also may be unsecured (no collateral) or secured (collateral required) depending on the specifics of the offer.

**PERSONAL LINE OF CREDIT:** A line of credit is a financial product that customers can borrow from at any time based on a preset limit. As long as the customer's account is open and their credit remains in good standing, they can borrow up to the maximum amount and pay interest only on the amount you actually borrow. As it is paid off over time, that credit may once again become available for the customer to borrow from.

#### How much can you borrow with Acorn Finance?

Acorn Finance's network of lenders extends loans from $2,000 up to $100,000 for qualified consumers.

#### How long does the loan approval process take?

Qualified applicants can be approved quickly during business hours and may receive their funds as soon as within 1 business day.
